chiru: Khan amani na thampui vara `khat ah awm Gadarenes ram ah va u joi.
english: Then they came to the other side of the sea, to the country of the Gadarenes.

chiru: Khan ama na rokong ah put ah vak shokphit `le, raikho rono alut miring `khat hi than ah put ah hawng shok rurawtawng puirelen.
english: And when He had come out of the boat, immediately there met Him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

chiru: Ama awmna kha thankung inih. Tute na ama kha thirakarui le khop ngam mak.
english: who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no one could bind him, not even with chains,

chiru: Ajarla shan hai, khan thirakarui hai kha le ama kha khop ua`awm, shan hai kha changhawt a thaw a thirakarui hai kha bawngbawng a irutet inih. Khan tute na`awm ama kha adek ngam ruawm mak.
english: because he had often been bound with shackles and chains. And the chains had been pulled apart by him, and the shackles broken in pieces; neither could anyone tame him.

chiru: Shunlejan a ama na thankung ah le maw chung ah enchak a rura`ai a, thiethien a ataksha kha lung le irit a ruawm jawnjai inih.
english: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains and in the tombs, crying out and cutting himself with stones.

chiru: Khan naitenu kha ukhut le rudawm a ama dieng rubiek, 'Talitha cumi.' Mahi 'Naitenu, kieina kieniebiek, thoi rang roh,' tina inih.
english: Then He took the child by the hand, and said to her, 'Talitha, cumi,' which is translated, 'Little girl, I say to you, arise.'

chiru: Kha phatak khan, naitenu kha othoi a hawng lawn joi, ajarla ama kha kum shawmlieidi runih joi. Khajarkhan amani kha shindawngna chung a shinrudawng pe uh.
english: Immediately the girl arose and walked, for she was twelve years of age. And they were overcome with great amazement.

chiru: Khan tute na hihaihi jetna boi rang, ama na chawngruben joi, khan naitenu kha nekleshak pekna rang, amani dieng ruriei pe joi.
english: But He commanded them strictly that no one should know it, and said that something should be given her to eat.
